name: Lost Legacy
effects:
15 single-target Fire/Ice/Lightning/Poison/NE ranged physical attacks, Critical Damage +50% to party, Awoken Engineer Mode, Cap Break Level 1, Quad Element Mode II & Relics of Heritage to user
Awoken Engineer Mode: Unlimited Machinist Hones, Machinist Ability Boost & Dualcast Machinist
Quad Element Mode II: En-Fire Stack, En-Ice Stack, En-Lightning Stack or En-Poison Stack
Relics of Heritage: [Fire/Ice/Lightning/Poison Damage +10%] or [Prismatic Damage +30%] to party with at least 0/4 T members
